source: Original approved forge image, inspected directly
supersedes: Single straight cylinder assumption in frame-orientation-candidate.json
observations: The rectangular bellows throat, exposed rounded neck, dark coupling ring and furnace flange are separate visible forms.
The neck broadens into a rounded end near the coupling; its outer contour is not a constant-width rectangle.
The flange extends above and below the neck and is partially occluded by the coupling. Its fitted full-outline ellipse includes edge thickness.

plannedParts.type: short round neck emerging from rectangular collar
rounded transition into separate coupling ring
short terminal section aligned with flange face normal

construction: Use a continuous closed swept surface through the neck stations, with smoothly changing tangent. Terminal tangent comes from the flange plane; initial tangent comes from the throat. Coupling ring is a separate thick annulus around the terminal section. No disconnected cylinders or arbitrary sharp elbow.
depthPolicy: Infer centerline depths jointly with flange normal and throat plane. Image-space centers alone do not determine depth or bend radius.
validation: Check neck outer silhouette independently of flange outline
Check coupling ring plane against flange face
Check physical overlap into throat and flange without hidden gaps
Reject a bend introduced solely to fit noisy or incorrect trace points
